import numpy as np

def image_captioning(image_features, vocab, max_length=20):
    caption = [vocab['<start>']]
    for _ in range(max_length):
        # Attention over image features
        scores = image_features @ decoder_weights['attn']
        weights = np.exp(scores) / np.sum(np.exp(scores))
        context = np.sum(weights[:, None] * image_features, axis=0)
        # Generate next token
        logits = decoder(context, caption)
        probs = np.exp(logits) / np.sum(np.exp(logits))
        next_token = np.argmax(probs)
        if next_token == vocab['<end>']:
            break
        caption.append(next_token)
    return [vocab_inv[t] for t in caption[1:]]
